name: Perphenazine-Amitriptyline
summary: Triavil is a single tablet that combines an antipsychotic (perphenazine) with a tricyclic antidepressant (amitriptyline) for depression that happens together with psychosis or anxiety, and it carries the side effect risks of both medicines.
description: Triavil combines perphenazine, a phenothiazine antipsychotic, with amitriptyline, a tricyclic antidepressant, to treat depression that happens together with psychosis or anxiety. It is usually prescribed for people with conditions such as schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder who also have significant depression. The combination lifts mood and treats psychosis in a single tablet, but it carries the side effect risks of both types of medicine.
